trust_decision.summary: Whether an untrusted XSLT input document may pull in external entities/DTDs, and whether document() may fetch external resources, is decided (at the pinned commit: not at all, only FEATURE_SECURE_PROCESSING is set) inside the JAXP-default XalanTransformerFactory wrapper, which passes every factory/transformer call straight to Xalan XSLTC.

landing_point.why: The summary names the forced Xalan TransformerFactory; its constructor is where the only hardening (secure processing) is set, so an engineer would try to add ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD/STYLESHEET attributes there.

fix_sites.entry_point: TransformerFactory.newInstance().newTransformer(Source) / newTransformer() (JAXP default via service file), then Transformer.transform(); fix wraps in SecuredTransformer (fix.diff:41629-41655, fix.diff:42030-42114)
TransformerFactory.newTemplates(Source).newTransformer() - the path camel-xslt xslt: endpoints use; fix wraps in SecuredTemplates (fix.diff:41641-41644, fix.diff:42007-42025)
TransformerFactory.setURIResolver/getURIResolver; fix keeps a restricting resolver on the delegate and consults the app resolver first (fix.diff:41661-41671)

fix_sites.module_kind: support library, SAX push lower-level API
support library, SAX filter lower-level API

fix_sites.entry_point: quarkus.camel.xslt.features config applied to xslt: endpoints; fix applies features to runtime-loaded templates too and warns when secure-processing is disabled (fix.diff:42201-42216)
fix_sites.module_kind: extension runtime recorder (config route, different module)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: extensions-support/xalan/runtime/src/main/java/org/apache/camel/quarkus/support/xalan/XalanTransformerFactory.java:119-147 (newTransformerHandler/newXMLFilter SAX push API, plus TransformerHandler.getTransformer() exposing the raw Xalan transformer, fix.diff:41710-41725); secondary: CamelXsltRecorder.java:93-111 in extensions/xslt

O3_reason_to_dismiss: camel-xslt only ever uses newTemplates()/newTransformer(), so the SAX push API (TransformerHandler/XMLFilter) and TemplatesHandler look like unused generic JAXP surface outside the xslt: endpoint the report is about; and the features property looks like an unrelated config bug.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: document() must keep resolving through the URIResolver camel-xslt sets on each transformer and through an app-set factory resolver; build-time translet compilation sets its own factory URIResolver for xsl:include; a SAXSource carrying a caller XMLReader and DOM/StAX sources pass untouched; systemId-only StreamSource must still transform. A deny-all resolver or always-replace-reader fix breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: StreamSource with systemId only, parsed by the secured reader not the delegate (fix.diff:41758-41760)
SAXSource with caller XMLReader, DOMSource, StAXSource passed through (fix.diff:41768-41769)
external general entity, external parameter entity, external DTD (fix.diff:42344-42361)
document() via Transformer, Templates, TransformerHandler, XMLFilter (fix.diff:41652-41655, 41723-41725, 41821-41836)
restriction kept after Transformer.reset() and setURIResolver(null) (fix.diff:42064-42067, fix.diff:42109-42113)

O7_producer.where: Upstream camel XmlConverter (not in this repo) hardens String/byte[]/InputStream bodies before the transformer; Source-shaped bodies (convertBodyTo(Source.class), component-produced Sources) skip it and reach Xalan's own parser (fix.diff:40975, fix.diff:41736-41739)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: SAXTransformerFactory.newTemplatesHandler() -> TemplatesHandler.getTemplates().newTransformer() returns an unwrapped Xalan transformer: no input-entity hardening and unrestricted document(); the fix's hunks skip this method.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: TemplatesHandler is a stylesheet-compilation API (stylesheets are documented as deployment owned) and camel-xslt never calls it; the fix's own docs list Transformer, Templates, TransformerHandler, XMLFilter but not TemplatesHandler.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as landing point, 80 lines below the constructor

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the translet-path RuntimeUriResolver returned instead of Camel's XsltUriResolver could fall through to unrestricted loading for unknown hrefs at transform time
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: it is a Quarkus-specific replacement resolver for build-time translets that a maintainer writes for native mode, separate from the factory wrapper

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a helper that turns getAssociatedStylesheet's Source into Templates without going through the secured newTemplates()
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the xml-stylesheet PI convenience path is a plausible addition next to the delegating methods

O9_family: XXE / external resource access in XSLT (CWE-611): lost JAXP 1.5 ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD/STYLESHEET hardening in a forced Xalan factory

O10_build.toolchain: Maven (mvnw), JDK 17+, Quarkus; QuarkusUnitTest in the deployment module (fix adds quarkus-junit-internal test dep, fix.diff:41071-41075)
O10_build.project_tests: extensions/xslt/deployment/src/test/java/org/apache/camel/quarkus/component/xslt/deployment/BuildTimeUriResolverTest.java; integration-test-groups/xml/jvm/xslt-bean and xslt-ref; fix adds extensions-support/xalan/deployment/src/test/.../XalanTransformerFactoryExternalAccessTest.java (absent at the pinned commit)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Set ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD/ACCESS_EXTERNAL_STYLESHEET attributes in the constructor (Xalan throws IllegalArgumentException for both, fix.diff:41579-41585), or harden newTransformer() only and leave Templates, handler, filter, reset() and setURIResolver(null) open.
